content_of_post_to_answer: Do you find it easier to focus on a speaker when you are taking notes?
answer: Yes, because note-taking changes listening from a passive activity into an active search for meaning. The mind starts asking, “What matters enough to write down?” which naturally filters distractions. I’ve written more about this connection between attention and learning on my profile, if you want to explore it further. The interesting part is that good notes are not a record of what was said; they are evidence of what your mind understood.
